newsitem.title: USA: Patriot to invest $300 million in Hilton venture.
newsitem.headline: Patriot to invest $300 million in Hilton venture.

text.p: Patriot American Hospitality Inc. will invest about $300 million to acquire, manage and develop a range of Hilton Hotels Corp. properties in key U.S. markets over the next several years, the companies said Monday.

Under the deal, Patriot will buy four Hilton Suites Hotels, totalling 883 suites, for $104.7 million. It will also develop about 15 new Hilton Garden Inns throughout the United States beginning this year.
The companies will also develop Hilton Suites in new markets and acquire upscale hotels and convert them to the Hilton brand, they said.
The alliance would add about 4,000 rooms to Patriot's portfolio of about 45 hotels and 10,923 rooms.

Patriot, a real estate investment trust based in Dallas, owns the properties, and has independent leasing arrangements with hotel operators, including Wyndham, Doubletree and Marriott. Its other brands include Crowne Plaza, Embassy Suites, Grand Heritage, Holiday Inn, Hyatt, Radisson, Registry, Sheraton Four Points and WestCoast.

"Patriot will provide a variety of asset management services, with Hilton responsible for branding, marketing, the reservation system and day-to-day property-level management," said Patriot President Thomas Lattin.
Hilton, based in Beverly Hills, Calif., develops, owns, manages and franchises hotels, hotel-casinos and resorts.
Patriot's stock rose $1.75 to $43.25, while Hilton fell $1 to $26.25 on the New York Stock Exchange in early afternoon.
